r3Implements.rule4-staff: Rules/Staff: a staff is pinned to hand.left / hand.right on the board when equipped and shown there (copy under NPC L Hand [LHnd] / NPC R Hand [RHnd] with Walking Stick's offsets, culled while drawn); a staff that is not in a hand takes no slot. A staff that reaches the inventory (pickup, script, container) is equipped into a free hand one frame later, off-hand first (Rules::StaffHand), and only a copy with no hand is refused by the reconcile (returned to its source, else the stash). A staff that leaves a hand (unequip, or a two-handed weapon / bow taking both hands = D3) is deposited one frame later with one HUD line; the follow-up waits while a menu or loading screen is up. The pickup gate accepts a staff only into a free hand ('No free hand for <name>').
r3Implements.gates: Rules/GateRules (pure, CTest) + Rules/Gates (ActorState::IsSwimming, GetSitSleepState, GetOccupiedFurniture, Actor::IsOnMount) + TESFurnitureEvent sink + Display/GatePoll (250 ms thread, one main-thread task at a time, only while an actor has a hand display, stops at DLL detach): the hand copy is hidden while any of equipped / !swimming / !sitting / !furniture / !mounted fails; one log line per transition
r3Implements.H9-hints: Rules/PlacementHints: per (actor, gear node) under a shared mutex; every plan publishes gear node 11 (staff, right hand) and 12 (left) = the slot's hint 16 while shown, 0 while gated or absent; cleared on Forget and at kNewGame / kPostLoadGame
r3Implements.oarConditions: Rules/OarConditions at kPostLoad through OAR_API::Conditions::GetAPI (V3): IED_GearNodePlacementHint (Gear node ID numeric, Comparison, Weapon placement ID numeric) and IED_GearNodeEquippedPlacementHint (Left hand bool, Comparison, Weapon placement ID numeric), the two Walking Stick's JSON uses, registered under this plugin's name and version; [Compat] OarLegacyPluginAlias=1 registers the second under the literal legacy name at 1.0.1.0. The other four names that provider defined are NOT registered (their component names are documented nowhere this tree may read; Nexus 98308's description names only 'Gear node ID' / 'Node name' for one of them).
r3Implements.D1-stash: dist/EnsrickEquipmentDisplay.esl (see eslRecords); [Storage] defaults to it; Storage::Deposit moves copies with TESObjectREFR::RemoveItem(..., toRef); dropping at the feet remains only the fallback when the reference does not resolve, with a warning naming the plugin
r3Implements.D2-final: the reconcile's overflow lands in the stash (same Storage::Deposit call site as R2); the self-test proves it with the Iron Mace
r3Implements.D3: a two-handed equip over a held staff: the engine's own unequip fires TESEquipEvent(unequipped) for the staff, and the one-frame-later follow-up finds it in no hand and deposits it
r3Implements.selfTest: 25 steps (13 from R2 with the stash instead of the drop, then the R3 steps: staff to the stash with both hands taken; staff into the free left hand with the hand.left copy, hints 12=16 / 11=0 and the two OAR conditions built through their own factories and evaluated on the player; draw/sheathe cull; the furniture gate on the nearest chair/bench via ActivateRef then IdleFurnitureExit; unequip to the stash; the staff again then an Iron Greatsword equipped over it)
